name: Joel
overview: The book of Joel, attributed to Joel the son of Pethuel, vividly portrays the coming day of the LORD as a time of both judgment and restoration, urging the people to respond with reverence and repentance. It declares the severity of God's judgments while also promising future blessings, including the outpouring of His Spirit on all people, enabling prophecy, dreams, and visions. Joel's message calls the faithful to trust in God's provision and renewal, as symbolized by the revival of the land and its fruitfulness after judgment.
